construct: TEMPLATE CELL (element-page restructure, owner rulings 2026-08-19): grain = DM element × energy element ×25 (20 relation pairs + 5 core self-pairs). Cell = mechanism (base 45-75w: the chemical reaction — 生/克 direction, what physically happens, why it seats as its relation noun; + catalyst_turn / friction_turn ≤35w each, role-resolved in the view, friction speaks the shadow noun) + function (primary = the seat's function per REA_02 §5f; body 40-70w energy-level, no god split; dips = 1-2 secondary lines ≤20w). Consolidates the law card + state verdict + persona bridge into section 1; section 2 = the function read; the gods move to Ruling Domains. Visual anchors derived, not stored: equation (cycles.js FEEDS/TAMES), image line (CYCLE_LINE), presence + role from the chart.

mechanism.base: Metal feeds water, as the old texts have it: dew beads on the blade at dawn, drawn from the air by the chill of the steel. The edge does not pour. It makes the water by being what it is, hard and cold and exact, and the drops gather on the clean line without any effort of its own. What the blade cannot say, the dew says for it, running off into the ground.
mechanism.catalyst_turn: With too little Water, the blade stays dry: everything is judged and nothing is said. The work of the edge never leaves the hand. Say one unfinished thing out loud this week.
mechanism.friction_turn: With too much Water, the edge washes away: every thought spoken the moment it forms, until nothing hard is left to speak from. Listen to the whole answer before you add yours.

function.definition_catalyst: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water makes it flow, and what you feel comes out. As a catalyst, the flow runs short. Your kindness and wit come out fast and then run dry.
function.definition_friction: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water pours it out until nothing stays in. As a friction, the gate never shuts, and more goes out of you than comes back. You run empty long before you run quiet.
function.definition_balanced: Your Expression is the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. Water makes it flow, and what you feel comes out. In balance, what goes out of you keeps pace with what comes back in. Your kindness and wit flow freely and still refill.
function.advise_catalyst: What you have to give runs short, and it counts for nothing until someone hears it. Tell one person a story with no lesson in it. Ask them what they took from it, and hear their whole answer.
function.advise_friction: Seek Earth, the Mind energy. Earth is the ground under the water, the bank that stills it until it clears. Let it hold what Water pours. You let it all out as it comes, and nothing stays in long enough to settle. Keep one piece of news to yourself for a week. Stick with one plan for a whole month.
function.advise_balanced: What you feel comes out freely, and the flow holds while you take in as much as you give. Tell one person a story with no lesson in it. Ask them what they took from it, and hear their whole answer.

candidates.cta_verdict: You say one true thing rather than ten pleasant ones, so you say as much by staying quiet as by speaking.

catalyst.clause: The blade stays dry: everything is judged and nothing is said.
catalyst.remedy: Say one unfinished thing out loud this week.

friction.clause: The edge washes away: every thought spoken the moment it forms.
friction.remedy: Listen to the whole answer before you add yours.

wide.clause: Water is easy for you to reach, the dew your edge draws from the cold air.
wide.remedy: Use it. Say the thing, send the page.

missing.clause: No dew on the blade: everything judged correctly and none of it ever said.
missing.remedy: Borrow a voice: write it down, read it to one person.

spared.clause: No water to wash the edge away, and the edge is better for it.
spared.remedy: Keep it so. Speak when something is finished.

thin.clause: Only a little water on the steel, enough to say what is done.
thin.remedy: Keep it small. Let most thoughts stay unsaid.

excess.clause: Too much water sinks the metal: so much poured out that the edge goes under.
excess.remedy: Pour less. Take in one slow thing a day.

catalyst.clause: This channel shows as pressure without release: much polished, little said.
catalyst.remedy: Writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the stone breathe.

wide.clause: There is no shortage of Water in you, the channel that lets the stone breathe.
wide.remedy: Say it while it is fresh. Ship the draft.

mechanism_yin.base: In the old reckoning water is metal's child: cold silver beads the morning dew, and metal, melted, runs bright as any river. The hard thing does not stay hard. At its finest facet it turns liquid, and what was fixed begins to flow, the clear stream carrying the stone's brightness out into the world.
mechanism_yin.catalyst_turn: Run thin, this channel shows as pressure without release: much polished, little said. That is why your chart asks you to feed it. Writing, speaking, sharing work early lets the stone breathe.
mechanism_yin.friction_turn: Run heavy, the flow turns to flood: output for its own sake, saying instead of shaping. The flood drinks the stone that feeds it. Cut the noise and the water clears.

__ore.retired_bonds_dip: People read your care through what you make for them, more than what you declare.
__ore.retired_fn_body: The Voice is your expression function: the gate where inner work becomes outer fact. With Water running it, expression in you flows rather than strikes. You persuade by permeating, the right word finding its level the way water finds a floor. When your Voice is fed, thought leaves you easily and lands soft. When it is dammed, you feel it as pressure at the throat and the hands.
__ore.retired_base_personal: Your core is Metal, and Metal feeds Water: dew beads on the cold blade. Whatever your core pours itself into becomes your Expression, the channel where what you are turns into what you say and make. Water adds nothing to your Metal. It carries it outward. Every sentence, every sketch, every offered comfort is your edge, condensed and set moving.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_catalyst:
Water is your Expression, and as a catalyst, it is the channel where your thinking becomes output: writing, speaking, showing work, even comfort offered well. You process by producing, and holding things in builds pressure you feel as restlessness before you name it as silence.

Fluent, articulate, better out loud than your drafts suggest. Clarity tends to arrive mid-sentence, moods lift after a long talk, and an idea stays tangled until the moment you explain it to someone else. What goes unsaid does not dissolve in you. It sits.

Expression is how you metabolize your life, so treat the outlet as survival rather than hobby. Keep one channel sacred, a journal, a weekly share, a standing call with someone who asks. Publish sooner than feels finished. Stuck on a decision, say it out loud first.
__ore.retired_v3_definition_friction:
Water is your Expression, and as a friction, it is output running ahead of your reserves: you keep producing, posting, and explaining while the energy behind it thins. The work still looks effortless, which is exactly why you miss the cost.

Generous with words, reliable on every thread, the one who always answers. Lately the conversations that used to feed you leave you emptied, and there is a widening gap between how fluent you sound and how much is actually left behind the fluency.

Quiet is where your voice refills, so ration it like income. Cut the channels to one for a month. Check that you have eaten and slept before agreeing to explain anything. And keep one thought a day entirely yours, on purpose.
